title: Create and Deeper and Darker Compat
description: adds sculk stone and gloomslate ores to crushing wheel. also there's amber blocks crushing into normal amber drops, aether amber, and cataclysm amethyst crab eggs.
body: Adds Crushing Wheel recipes for Sculk Stone ores, Gloomslate ores that map exactly to the outputs of the vanilla Stone and Deepslate ores respectively. Also there's a recipe for the amber blocks into the normal drops from the amber blocks (same chances) + aether amber + cataclysm amethyst crab egg at a very low chance.
